MESSAGE:
Dear Acme Cloud Services Team,

Thank you for your email regarding renewal of our services agreement currently ending 31 October 2026. We are open to renewing for a further 12 months under Clause 8.1 of our agreement, subject to the following.

The proposed 12% increase exceeds the renewal price cap of 7% set out in Clause 8.2, and also exceeds the maximum increase we are able to accept under our internal procurement policy without competitive bidding. Our current annual fee is Rs 24,00,000 (Rs 2,00,000 per month). We are prepared to discuss an increase within the Clause 8.2 cap, or up to a higher level only if accompanied by clear cost justification for review and approval on our side. As it stands, we are not able to accept a 12% increase and would need to move to competitive bidding if a mutually agreeable figure cannot be reached.

Separately, under Clause 4.1/4.2, your service fell below the 99.9% monthly uptime target in May 2026 (99.42%) and July 2026 (99.61%), resulting in service credits owed of Rs 20,000, which have not yet been claimed or applied. Per our internal policy, these credits must be settled before we can finalize any renewal.

Please could you: (1) apply the Rs 20,000 service credit to our account, and (2) respond with a revised pricing proposal within the Clause 8.2 cap, or supporting justification for a higher figure, so we can proceed with renewal discussions promptly.

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
Nimbus Retail Procuremen
